page.layout: Running head at top: page number 162 left, title "Animalium Mar. Ordo XII." centred. Below the title, two captions: left caption under the large skull engraving; right caption above the uterus engraving. Then, right column: a paragraph-caption beside the coin engraving; below, a small caption under the dolphin coin. Figures are plates, not text.

main_text.l: Ex eodem, Delphini matricis cum fœtu efformati-
Ex eodem, Antiquissimi numismatis ærei pi-
ctura: quod Delphinos duos dorso repando curuos
ostendit, non quòd eiusmodi uere sint: sed ita picto-
res alij, ad impetum opinor eorum, sagittæ instar
è neruo sese iaculantium, exprimendum, fingere

page.notes: Figures: a large lateral view of a dolphin skull (left, spanning most of the page); an engraving of a dolphin uterus with foetus (upper right); a coin engraving with a dolphin-bearing reverse (middle right); a coin engraving showing two dolphins around a star (lower right). The caption "DELPHINVS" sits beneath the lower coin. Long s rendered as s; the right caption's hyphenated line ends are printed as "pi-ctura" and "pictores" as printed.
